patterns.label: Fixed line — Mogadishu (021) and Federal Member State codes (02X)

notes: Somali numbering was largely unregulated between 1991 and the establishment of the National Communications Authority in 2017; NSN length is inconsistent across operators, so length-based validation is unreliable.
Fixed-line area codes were standardised in 2021 around an 02X series for the Federal Member States.
Somaliland, which declares independence but is internationally recognised as part of Somalia, also uses +252 — the country code does not distinguish the two.
sources: NCA Somalia — National Communications Authority: https://nca.gov.so/
